_why:
The card's `places` field meant TWO DIFFERENT THINGS in two scripts. nr-check.mjs reads it as the PRICED count; settle.mjs read it as a settlement OVERRIDE. So a nursery priced at 3 places that shed three runners and ran six settled at the priced 3 instead of the band's 2, and rule 16's 'place band moved' line could never fire — the override had made the two numbers agree by construction. Caught 17 Oct 2026 settling Future Champions Saturday's 16:50 (9 declared, 6 ran).

Two races, because the two tables only differ above 15 runners and only a handicap carries the 16+ band — a test inside one band cannot see the other (the lesson CLAUDE.md records from settle.mjs's race_name bug).

Expect: 16:50 settles at 2 places with a BAND MOVED warning and 'Third' unplaced; 15:40 settles the advertised offer of 7 and pays 'Fifth'. Priced-at numbers must never win.

The 15:40 also pins the OTHER half of the depth test: 28 ran, an advertised seven places, and the result published only to 4th. 'Deep Unknown' is absent from it and must come back UNRESOLVED with a non-zero exit, because the result stops short of the place count — that is the Cambridgeshire case, where three picks genuinely could not be settled. Contrast Future Champions' Cesarewitch: four places, published to four, so an absent pick is a confirmed loser. Same shape, opposite verdict, and the depth is what separates them.
